sql: SELECT order_id, DECODE(status, 1, 'active', 0, 'inactive', 'unknown') AS status_label FROM orders
SELECT customer_id, DECODE(region, 'US', 'domestic', 'CA', 'domestic', 'intl') AS geo FROM customers

notes: Raw Oracle NVL and COALESCE hang/recurse in the converter; IS NOT NULL is the safe stand-in plus DECODE cases above.
sql: SELECT customer_id, email FROM customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL
SELECT SYSDATE AS right_now FROM dual
SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS ym, amount FROM orders
SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
SELECT id, created_at::timestamp, (payload)::text AS payload_txt FROM events
SELECT id, payload::jsonb FROM events WHERE payload IS NOT NULL
SELECT order_id, DATEADD(day, 7, order_date) AS next_week FROM orders
SELECT campaign_id, DATEADD(month, 1, start_date) AS next_month FROM campaigns
SELECT order_id, GETDATE() AS loaded_at FROM orders
SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at) AS rn FROM orders
SELECT customer_id, amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rnk FROM orders
WITH paid AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total FROM paid WHERE total > 100
WITH base AS (SELECT customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'), tot AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM base GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total FROM tot
SELECT id FROM east_orders UNION SELECT id FROM west_orders
SELECT id, 'east' AS region FROM east_orders UNION ALL SELECT id, 'west' AS region FROM west_orders
SELECT 1
SELECT 1 AS one, 'x' AS label
SELECT id, amount FROM {schema}.orders WHERE status = 'paid'
SELECT id FROM {foo.bar} WHERE id > 0
SELECT o.id, c.name, o.amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid'
SELECT id, CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid_flag FROM orders
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT id FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE region = 'EU')
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(amount) > 500
SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'A%'
SELECT id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr FROM orders
SELECT id, status FROM orders WHERE status IS NOT NULL
SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id
SELECT DISTINCT region, country FROM customers
SELECT id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC, id
SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE id > 0
